contexts.text: Under Angel, see these references. AC 737. AC 751. AC 761. AC 1683. AC 5954:8.
The good are in their veriest life... when they can perform the use of defending others from evils.
Under Bow, see this reference.
Angels from the Lord, that is, the Lord, defend (the rational mind).
Probity defends itself.
Man cannot undergo temptations before, because he is not as yet in the Knowledges whereby to defend himself.
Truth is assaulted by the evil Spirits, and defended by the Angels who are with the man...
Towers = the interior truths which defend those things which are of love and charity.
(When this ultimate truth is withdrawn) the spiritual man no longer has anything wherewith to defend himself against the natural man. Signified. AC 5009:end. AC 5022. AC 5028:2.
Under Temptation, see these references. AC 6097. AC 8960. AC 8975.
As soon as a man who is in truth and not yet in good brings anything into act from a religious principle, he afterwards defends it as if it were the veriest truth.
A wall = the truths of faith which defend. Illustrated.
He who defends his opinion... confirms it.
Fortifications = truths, in so far as they defend goods.

What a man loves he confirms and defends, and evils cannot be confirmed and defended except by means of falsities. The reason they who are in evils think to the falsities by which they defend evils, is that evils are the very delights of their life...
Such, after having for some little time defended evils by falsities, persuade themselves that evils are goods, and falsities truths.
To plead their suit = to defend and deliver from falsities.
They maintain that the natural man cannot apprehend the things of faith.
The zeal of a good love... never breaks forth against the other, but only defends itself; and it defends itself against evil as when this rushes into a fire and is burnt up.
It is otherwise when men defend themselves from their enemies... for this is to be considered as a just defence...
He was of those who have... defended (the knowledges of faith) with zeal... but now knew nothing.
The skull... which defends (the brain).
The evil Spirits attack, and the good only defend.
Societies of Spirits have their own proper defences.
Every animal has its own defence.
Whatever opinion they take up... they defend...
When (Swab) defended himself against the evil...
They who are in falsities always make the attack, but they who are in truths only defend.
2. (2nd series). Hence come... the defences of disagreeing dogmas within the Church.
He is also the aggressor, when aggression is defence.
